name: @pipeworx/mcp-reliefweb

tools.name: reliefweb_reports
tools.description: Humanitarian situation reports, needs assessments, appeals, analyses and press releases published on ReliefWeb by ~4,000 UN agencies, NGOs, governments and research bodies. AUTHORITATIVE for "what do humanitarian responders say is happening in <country or crisis>" — this is UN OCHA's own corpus, not news coverage of it. Filter by country, disaster, disaster type, publishing organisation, theme, document format and publication date, or free-text search the title and body. Returns title, publishing source, primary country, disaster, format, publication date and the ReliefWeb URL. Requires a caller-supplied ReliefWeb appname in _apiKey.

query.description: Free-text search over title and body, e.g. "cholera outbreak", "cash assistance".

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Sudan" or "SDN".

source.description: Publishing organisation name or shortname, e.g. "OCHA", "WFP", "UNHCR".

theme.description: Humanitarian theme, e.g. "Food and Nutrition", "Health", "Protection and Human Rights", "Shelter and Non-Food Items".

format.description: Document format, e.g. "Situation Report", "Assessment", "Appeal", "Analysis", "News and Press Release", "Map".

from_date.description: Only reports published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-08-01".

to_date.description: Only reports published on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

include_body.description: Include a text excerpt of each report body (default false — bodies are long and most callers want the list first).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: reliefweb_disasters
tools.description: The ReliefWeb disaster register — UN OCHA's curated list of humanitarian emergencies, each with a GLIDE number, disaster type, affected countries, event date and whether it is ongoing, alert or past. AUTHORITATIVE for "which humanitarian emergencies are active right now" and for resolving a crisis to the identifier the rest of the humanitarian system uses. Filter by country, status or disaster type, or search the name. Requires a caller-supplied ReliefWeb appname in _apiKey.

query.description: Free-text search over disaster name and description, e.g. "Horn of Africa".

country.description: Country name or ISO3 code, e.g. "Afghanistan" or "AFG".

status.description: Disaster status: "ongoing", "alert" or "past". Omit for all.

include_description.description: Include the disaster description text (default false).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: reliefweb_report
tools.description: One ReliefWeb report in full — the complete body text, every attached file, the publishing organisations, the countries and disasters it covers, its theme and format, and its publication and revision dates. Use it after reliefweb_reports to read a situation report rather than only its title. Pass the numeric report id from a reliefweb_reports result. Requires a caller-supplied ReliefWeb appname in _apiKey.

report_id.description: Numeric ReliefWeb report id, as returned by reliefweb_reports, e.g. "4142589".

max_body_chars.description: Truncate the body to this many characters (default 8000, max 40000).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-reliefweb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the reliefweb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
